S No directions and  Registrar's order with  Signatures  04.09. C528 No.1564 of 2025  2025  Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.

The present Application has been filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for quashing the entire proceedings of Complaint Case No.3654 of 2023, pending before the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kashipur, District Udham Singh Nagar under Sections 323, 498A, 506 and Section 120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2. Heard Mr. D.C.S. Rawat, learned counsel for the applicants and Mr. Himanshu Sain, learned Brief Holder for the respondent no.1.
3. Mr. D.C.S. Rawat, Advocate, has submitted that the applicant no.1 is the sister-in-law (Nanad) of the informant and the applicant no.2 is the husband of the applicant no.1.

They are residing separately and they have no concern with the day today affairs of the complainant and his husband (co-accused).
4.
Notice is being issued to the respondent no.2- complainant.
Steps to be taken within a week.
Till then, the further proceedings of the said Complaint Case No.3654 of 2023 are stayed qua the applicants - accused Smt. Pooja and Surendra Singh alias Sulendra Singh.
6. Stay Application (IA No.1 of 2025) stands disposed of accordingly.

(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 04.09.2025 Pant/
